page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highcpu-4 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the c4d server family. It features 4 dedicated virtual CPUs (vCPUs) paired with 7.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a resource density of 1.75 GB of RAM per core. This low memory-to-CPU ratio positions the instance as a compute-optimized resource.

The instance does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached volumes. Additionally, it does not provide complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the c4d-highcpu-4 offers a lean hardware profile designed to minimize memory overhead expenses for CPU-bound tasks. This makes it suitable for workloads that require dedicated compute power but have modest memory footprints, such as lightweight web serving, batch processing, and microservices.
